meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把素材和脚本拼成有品牌风格的成片或混剪视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有素材和脚本,想做成一条完整的品牌片或混剪。
copy.tagline_en: Turn footage and a script into a finished branded video or montage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have footage and a script and need a finished reel or montage.

howto.what: 没有专用工作流可用时，Claude 会用它创作或编辑自定义 HyperFrames 视频合成，产出多场景长片、品牌片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。全新创作先走 /hyperframes。
howto.when: 当没有专用工作流适用、BRIEF.md 里 flow 为 companion，或要制作多场景长片、品牌片、素材混剪等时接管；全新创作先经 /hyperframes，短片动效单元用 motion-graphics。

say.text: 用 general-video 做一支三场景的品牌片
say.note: 会先规划场景与节奏再搭建合成

say.text: 把这段素材剪成蒙太奇，重新排序并加旁白
say.note: 同一视频源复制成多段剪辑并设定区间

say.text: BRIEF.md 里把 flow 设成 companion，我们边聊边做
say.note: 先给完整方案，再由你删减

howto.what_en: With no specialized workflow fitting, Claude uses this skill to author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition: multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes. Fresh creation routes through /hyperframes first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits, BRIEF.md sets flow: companion, or the job is a multi-scene piece, brand reel, montage, etc. Fresh builds route through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Use general-video to build a three-scene brand reel.
say_en.note: Plans scenes and rhythm before building

say_en.text: Cut this footage into a montage, reorder it and add narration.
say_en.note: Duplicates the source into clips with set ranges

say_en.text: Set flow: companion in BRIEF.md so we co-create.
say_en.note: Offers a full treatment you then trim
